mapper.insert: insert into book (bo_isbn, bo_ca_code, bo_thum, bo_title, bo_publisher, bo_date,bo_price, bo_sale_price, bo_ea, bo_intro, bo_index,bo_author,bo_translator, bo_detail_page, bo_detail_size, bo_detail_weight) values (#{bo.bo_isbn}, #{bo.bo_ca_code}, #{bo.bo_thum}, #{bo.bo_title}, #{bo.bo_publisher}, #{bo.bo_date}, #{bo.bo_price}, #{bo.bo_sale_price}, #{bo.bo_ea}, #{bo.bo_intro},#{bo.bo_index}, #{bo.bo_author}, #{bo.bo_translator}, #{bo.bo_detail_page},#{bo.bo_detail_size},#{bo.bo_detail_weight})
mapper.select:
select * from book
where (bo_title like concat('%', #{cri.search} ,'%') or bo_author like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%') or bo_publisher like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%'))
where ${cri.searchType} like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%')
order by bo_isbn desc limit #{cri.pageStart}, #{cri.perPageNum}

select count(*) from book
where (bo_title like concat('%', #{cri.search} ,'%') or bo_author like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%') or bo_publisher like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%'))
where ${cri.searchType} like concat('%',#{cri.search},'%')
mapper.insert: insert into basket (ba_me_id, ba_bo_isbn, ba_bo_front, ba_bo_title, ba_bo_price, ba_bo_sale_price, ba_ea) values (#{ba.ba_me_id}, #{ba.ba_bo_isbn}, #{ba.ba_bo_front}, #{ba.ba_bo_title}, #{ba.ba_bo_price}, #{ba.ba_bo_sale_price}, #{ba.ba_ea})
mapper.delete: delete from basket where ba_me_id = #{ba.ba_me_id} and ba_bo_isbn = #{ba.ba_bo_isbn}
mapper.select: select * from basket where ba_me_id = #{ba.ba_me_id} and ba_bo_isbn = #{ba.ba_bo_isbn}
mapper.insert: insert into review (rv_me_id, rv_review, rv_rating, rv_bo_isbn, rv_title) select #{rv.rv_me_id},#{rv.rv_review},#{rv.rv_rating},#{rv.rv_bo_isbn}, bo_title from book where bo_isbn = #{rv.rv_bo_isbn}
mapper.select: select count(*) from review where rv_bo_isbn = #{bo_isbn}
